summary.intent: Wrap up the Callisto release fixes (#550, #551), evaluate adopting michi 0.10 pieces, re-verify and rewrite NEXT-WORK.md, then tackle all open items agentically with minimal ceremony.
summary.outcome: Pushed both fixes with findings resolved, rewrote and installed NEXT-WORK.md after three verification agents, and launched three worktree agents (matrix triples, Dag::descendants swap, michi 0.10 analysis) while committing and pushing the spec doc fixes in release.json and versioning.json.

repo: Only callisto-model is MIT; callisto-graph, callisto-manifests, callisto-cli and callisto-fixtures are FSL-1.1-MIT. ARCHITECTURE.md:10 forbids FSL deps only in callisto-model, and deny.toml already allows FSL.
Callisto depends only on michi-graph = "0.9" (workspace Cargo.toml), used by callisto-graph and callisto-model. A pre-1.0 minor requirement will not auto-pick 0.10.
docs/errors.md and the code both have 278 error codes, and error_registry_architecture.rs enforces both directions plus unique numeric codes.
Spec drift is far lower than the October review's 14%: a 65-criterion sample of 262 found 61 true, 2 partly true, 0 false.
NEXT-WORK.md is git-excluded, and the worktree guard blocks writes to the shared checkout path, so the plan file needed to be installed another way.
The E320 version-commit guard (#290) was fixed in #326, which walks first-parent history uncapped and compares by tree content.
E194 (fixed groups can't share a tag or release title) is decided against as of 2026-11-14; keep the init guard and migration guidance.

code.finding: Hand-written 18-triple triple_host_runner_use_cross table that duplicates napi::triple_to_role, leaving two parallel triple lists.
dependents_of is #[cfg(test)] and could be replaced by Dag::descendants (about 12 lines) once root exclusion is confirmed.

parse_retry_after, parse_http_date and days_from_civil (about 55 lines) could be replaced by michi_core::parse_retry_after_at, but edge behaviour differs (+5 accepted and overflow returns None here, versus rejected and saturating in michi).
is_registry_effect and the eligible_in ancestor check are candidates for replacement by michi 0.10 ready_by_edge, which is not yet confirmed to exist in 0.10.0.
Version-commit guard compares by tree content, so reverts and merge-only changes count the same as plain commits.

workflow: The user prefers the agent do installs and chores itself instead of handing back drafts or commands; this is now recorded in memory.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions; verify claims such as Dag::descendants semantics before acting.
Resolve Entire findings before pushing a fix.
Read-only verification agents run in parallel, then the plan is rewritten from their combined findings.
The plan file was 24 days stale and several items had since shipped, so verify a plan against current code before presenting it.

friction: Earlier in the session the assistant recommended dropping #551 on weak grounds, and the user pushed back, so it was reversed.
The user asked about a new Callisto release, but nothing new had shipped; it was the same 0.21.0, and 0.21.1 was in fact released by the time of the later check.
The worktree guard blocked writing NEXT-WORK.md to the shared checkout, which led to a draft-and-copy handoff the user rejected.
Subagents were sandbox-blocked from writing to the jobs dir and built into /tmp/claude-501/target instead.
open_items: Three agents are still running: the matrix triple table refactor, the Dag::descendants swap (needs a root-exclusion check) and the michi 0.10 analysis (whether ready_by_edge can replace eligible_in and is_registry_effect).
Spec fixes to release.json and versioning.json were pushed (REL-ERR-02 E309, VER-APPLY-17 duplicate, VER-APPLY-20 stray comma) but a PR and CI are not confirmed.
OIDC trusted publishing needs the owner's decision on id-token: write for the execute job.
GitHub immutable releases are still off.
Root-level npm pins are not rewritten; decide whether to error or document.
Delete the stale remote branch origin/fix/version-lock-refresh-rollback.
The PyPI and Cargo registry binding path has no real-registry test.
Read the weekly sweep result on Monday.
The optional Retry-After swap to michi-core is skipped for now.

The Corpus-pending items carried over unchecked: private and HTML-only PyPI, npm channel promotion, checksums, wrapper bump severity, inferred-only releases, release-commit provenance and the no-output publish limit.
